name: José Luis Becerra
office: Lennox School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: José Luis Becerra is a wildlife trapper running for the Lennox School District Governing Board. He says he started his wildlife removal business, The Critter Trapper, in 2008. In 2025, he opposed the school board's plan to close Felton Elementary, saying the district had a plan to close the school but none to keep it open.
